thread.title: Is the Tech Stock Trade Dying Out?

author: Home
title: Is the Tech Stock Trade Dying Out?
text:
Watch those tech stocks.
The Tech Trade The once hot tech trade is again under siege . Bearish comments from a KLA-Tencor ( KLAC ) executive on Thursday and a continued sell-off in Facebook ( FB ) are red flags for the bulls.
Goldman On Apple Goldman Sachs is coming out more upbeat on Apple ( AAPL ) ahead of the tech giant's Sept. 12 product event . The investment bank cites Apple's services business as a key factor in lifting their price target on the stock to $240 from $200.
Around TheStreet Pernard Ricard chairman and CEO Alexandre Ricard admits operating a liquor business in 86 countries amid trade wars isn't easy. TheStreet's @EricJhonsa says the ugly sell-off in Micron ( MU ) on Thursday isn't panic selling.
